description: This Dart source file defines a RestaurantProfile class encapsulating details about a restaurant (name, story, contact info, operating hours, etc.) and a RestaurantProvider class that manages the profile, including loading data, checking if the restaurant is open, and formatting today's hours. The provider uses services for notifications and geolocation and provides methods for profile initialization and status updates.

classes.name: RestaurantProfile
classes.description: A data class representing all relevant information about a restaurant including name, story, contact details, address, operating hours, and social media handle.

classes.name: RestaurantProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class managing the restaurant profile state, including loading, profile data, open status, and formatted hours. It utilizes external services for notifications and geolocation.

methods.name: loadProfile
methods.description: Asynchronously loads or refreshes the restaurant profile, currently seeded with static data.

methods.name: isOpenNow
methods.description: Calculates whether the restaurant is currently open based on the current time and its operating hours.

methods.name: todayHoursFormatted
methods.description: Returns a string describing today's operating hours formatted in 'hh:mm am/pm - hh:mm am/pm'.

methods.name: _seedProfile
methods.description: Creates a default RestaurantProfile object with predefined details including operating hours for each day of the week.
